moral: Trying new experiences can turn fear into joy.

scenes.summary: Panu makes friends and discovers that school is fun.

He played games.

He learned new things.

And he made new friends.

His mother smiled.

“I knew you would enjoy it.”

New places can feel scary at first.

But they can become fun once you try.

The End

story:
Panu the Panda Who Was Afraid of School

In a quiet bamboo forest, lived a little panda named Panu.

Panu loved to play, eat bamboo, and nap in the sunshine.

But there was one thing Panu did not like…

Going to school.

“School starts today!” said his mother.

Panu hid behind a tree.

“I don’t want to go,” he said.

“What if it’s hard?”

“What if I don’t make friends?”

Panu slowly walked to school.

He saw many animals there.

They were talking, laughing, and learning.

Panu felt shy.

He sat quietly in a corner.

Just then, Milo the Bear Teacher came over.

“Hello, Panu,” he said warmly.

“Would you like to join us?”

Panu nodded slowly.

The class began with drawing.

Panu loved drawing!

He picked up a crayon and started.

Soon, he was smiling.

“Look!” he said.

“I made a bamboo tree!”

The other animals clapped.

“That’s beautiful!” they said.

Soon, Panu was talking and laughing.

He played games.

He learned new things.

And he made new friends.

At the end of the day, Panu ran home.

“I love school!” he said.

“I was scared before, but it’s fun!”

His mother smiled.

“I knew you would enjoy it.”

New places can feel scary at first.

But they can become fun once you try.

The End
